빨갛다.n: everyday spoken word for vivid red

slip and fall by missing one's step; written or news style
to lose one's reputation; to fall in standing
formal; reputation, honor or authority falls, written style
Compound with meaning lose completely by accident; mostly for physical objects.
lose a game or contest; casual, everyday

huge towering mountain — literary, also figurative for big trouble
climbing down a mountain; going down a mountain
coming down a mountain after hiking — hiking talk, formal-neutral
